description: This file defines the 'LineFormatRenderer' class, which handles rendering line formats onto a graphics context within the MigraDoc document rendering engine. It manages properties such as color, width, and dash style, and provides methods to generate drawing pens and render lines as rectangles.

classes.name: LineFormatRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering a line format onto a graphics surface, including handling color, width, and style settings.

methods.name: LineFormatRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a line format and graphics context.

methods.name: GetColor
methods.description: Determines the color to be used for rendering based on the line format.

methods.name: GetWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of the line for rendering.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Draws the line as a rectangle on the graphics context at specified position, size, applying the line style.

methods.name: GetPen
methods.description: Creates a pen with the appropriate color, width, and dash style for drawing.
